# `reports/gadget_pkdgrav3_potential/make_figures.py`

Source: [make_figures.py](../../../../reports/gadget_pkdgrav3_potential/make_figures.py)

```text
Figures of the report other than the stacked potentials (those: stack_potential.ipynb).

usage: make_figures.py <run>=<compare dir> [<run>=<compare dir> ...] [--figs figs]
  compare dir: output of job_compare.pbs (particles.csv, snap_*.npz, halos/halo_mf.csv, halos/halo_match*.{csv,npz})
  e.g. make_figures.py 32=data/pkd32_vs_gadget32_r1 256=../../tmp.nosync/cmp256
```

## Contents

- [`load_csv`](#load_csv) - Read a CSV file; returns (dict of float arrays, list of row dicts).
- [`particles_vs_z`](#particles_vs_z) - Figure: particle-potential comparison statistics of the runs `R` against 1 + z; saved to `out`.
- [`snap_scatter`](#snap_scatter) - Figure: particle-by-particle potential scatter of the last snapshot of `run`.
- [`halo_mf`](#halo_mf) - Figure: halo mass functions of both codes and their ratio for `run`.
- [`halo_match`](#halo_match) - Figure: mass, position and potential ratios of matched halos against redshift for `run`.
- [`halo_potential`](#halo_potential) - Figure: per-halo potential of the two codes from `halos.csv` for `run`.
- [`main`](#main) - Command line: `make_figures.py <run dir>... [--figs DIR]`: all comparison figures of each run.
